---
title: Nobody Knows My Name Here
hook_line: Nobody knows my name here yet
central_image: a key that does not fit any door yet
arc: [arrive unseen, choose to stay, a stranger says my name]
title_rationale: the hook withholds its last word until the chorus lands
---

## Notes

The verses collect small proofs of anonymity (a wrong name on a lease, a bus route learned upside down). The pre-chorus turns the anonymity into a choice; the chorus answers it with the key, the door, and the suitcase set down. The bridge imagines the day the corner shop knows the order without asking.
